summary: Learning path card: gradient icon tile, title (optionally a link covering the whole card), description, meta (level, duration), the user's “x / y modules” progress on a progress bar or a “New” chip, and a footer for an action.
whenToUse: Catalog of paths, courses or learning paths on a community or academy page.
Resuming a started path by showing how many modules are left.
whenNotToUse: Progress of an operation (upload, loading): use Progress.
Sequential steps of a flow to complete now: use Stepper.

props.name: title
props.description: Path name; also the accessible name of the card and the bar.

props.name: href
props.description: Path URL: the title becomes a link whose clickable area covers the whole card.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon in the gradient tile.

props.name: meta
props.description: Short details: level, duration, number of modules.

props.name: completed
props.description: Modules completed by the user (clamped between 0 and total).

props.name: total
props.description: Total modules: the bar appears if it is > 0 and completed is set.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action, note or link at the bottom; stays clickable above the extended link.

inherits: HTML attributes of <article> (id, style, data-*, aria-*).

keyboard.action: Reaches the title link (if href) and then the interactive elements in the footer.

accessibility: The card is an <article> named by its title (aria-labelledby).

Progress uses Progress (role="progressbar") named by the title, with aria-valuemin/max/now and a localized aria-valuetext (“5 / 8 modules”); the visible text below the bar is aria-hidden to avoid repetition.
The “New” chip is text, not just color; the icon is decorative.
With href there is a single link: the clickable area is extended with a pseudo-element and the focus ring is drawn around the whole card.
In forced-colors, borders use CanvasText; with prefers-reduced-motion hovering does not move the card.
responsive: Column layout that works from 320px; meta and footer wrap.
In a grid (Grid minItemWidth ≈16rem) the bar and footer align at the bottom.
customization: Tokens: --dc-gradient-accent / --dc-gradient-accent-subtle for the icon tile, --dc-look-radius-container, --dc-look-shadow-primary; the bar inherits the Progress style (gradient in the expressive look).
commonMistakes: Hand-writing “5 / 8 modules”: pass completed and total, the text is localized.
Passing a percentage as completed with total 100: you lose the module count.
Wrapping the card in an <a> with buttons inside: use href.
